description: This Java source file defines the UnitsComboBoxEditor class, a custom cell editor for a JTable component that allows editing unit selection via a JComboBox. It facilitates interaction with ECU data, specifically providing a user interface component for selecting data convertors related to ECU parameters within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: UnitsComboBoxEditor
classes.description: A custom cell editor for JTable that provides a JComboBox for selecting ECU data convertors, integrating seamlessly with ECU data models and supporting user interaction within the table interface.

methods.name: getCellEditorValue
methods.description: Returns the selected convertor from the current ECU data, used to retrieve the value after editing.

methods.name: getTableCellEditorComponent
methods.description: Provides the JComboBox component for editing, populated with available convertors and set to the current selection.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles action events from the JComboBox, updating the ECU data's selected convertor and stopping editing upon user selection.
